description: This file defines the CatalogItemService class implementing ICatalogItemService, responsible for CRUD operations and data fetching related to catalog items, integrating with external lookup services and HTTP client.

classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: Service class providing operations for catalog items, including create, read, update, delete, and listing with associated lookup data enrichment.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item by posting data to API and returns the created item.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Updates an existing catalog item via PUT request.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item identified by its ID, returning status message.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Fetches a catalog item by ID, enriching it with brand and type names.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items with lookup data enrichment.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves a complete list of catalog items with lookup data enrichment.
